name: Combined Triad + Ladder Front Door
summary: Unified entry point for RTT’s intelligence architecture, combining the Triad micro-measurement system with the Intelligence Class Ladder macro-classification system.
purpose: Provide a single canonical front door that introduces the Triad (Scanner, O.H.S.H.I.T., Atlas) and the Ladder (AAI, AGI, SI), explaining how detection, hashing, and mapping feed into macro-classification.
